to: one socket: the socket that connects, the observer or the character that goes to a generated map

fields.name: run
fields.description: The key of the cave run: 24 hexadecimal characters.

fields.name: index
fields.description: The number of this part, from 0. Parts arrive in order.

fields.name: count
fields.description: The number of parts. The official client accepts 1 to 1,400 (js/generated_zones.js:9-10).

fields.name: text
fields.description: Up to 12,000 characters of the JSON text of a `MapChunkBundle`.

confirm.note: Nothing is sent when `map_protocol` in the handshake query is not 1: `send_generated_maps` throws `client_update_required` (node/logic/generated_maps.js:186).

MapChunkBundle.summary: The JSON text that the `map_chunk` parts of one floor make, joined in `index` order.

fields.name: run
fields.description: The key of the cave run, the same as `map_chunk.run`.

fields.name: floors
fields.description: The floor that the socket goes to. The server sends one floor each time.

fields.name: manifest
fields.description: All floors of the run, in floor order (node/logic/dream_layout.js:1230).

fields.name: key
fields.description: The map name of the floor: `zone_<run>_<floor number>`.

fields.name: definition
fields.description: The `G.maps` entry of the floor, without `data`. `definition.generated` has `run` and `floor`.

fields.name: geometry
fields.description: The geometry of the floor, the same form as `G.geometry` entries. With `no_graphics=1` it has only `x_lines`, `y_lines`, `min_x`, `min_y`, `max_x`, `max_y`, and empty `tiles`, `placements`, `groups` and `animations`.

fields.name: navigation
fields.description: Only with `no_graphics=1`: the walk map of the floor (`floor.amap`).

MapChunkManifestEntry.summary: One floor in the `manifest` of a `MapChunkBundle`.

fields.name: key
fields.description: The map name of the floor: `zone_<run>_<floor number>`.

fields.name: definition
fields.description: The `G.maps` entry of the floor that the server builds: `name` (`"Cave of Many Dreams"`), `spawns`, `doors`, `generated` (`run`, `floor`, `version`, `zone`), `rooms` and more.

senders.what: `send_generated_maps`. It sends nothing when the map is not generated, or when the socket already has this floor.
The `connection` handler, before `welcome`, for an observer that follows a character in a generated map.
`transport_player_to`, before `new_map`: a cave door, `enter` of the dream cave, or a return to a cave run.
